about: Sources used in the Studio that the earlier research tables do not list, or that need a connector. Kept by hand. build-sources.mjs adds them to sources.json.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.use: Studio lighting images, surface textures and models

sources.name: Sketchfab
sources.licenceText: Per model: CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-NC and others. Read the label of each model.
sources.use: Ready 3D models; the search is open, the download needs an account

sources.name: RCSB Protein Data Bank
sources.use: Experimental structures of proteins, nucleic acids and complexes

sources.name: PubMed
sources.licenceText: Records are free; the licence of each article differs.
sources.use: Find papers and their DOIs. A record gives the abstract only, never the full text.

sources.name: PubMed Central
sources.licenceText: Open full texts; the licence of each article differs.
sources.use: Full texts of open articles, the way to ground a claim

sources.name: HAL open archive
sources.use: Open copies of French research papers. Check that the file body matches the cover page: one deposit held a different paper.

sources.name: 3D ContentCentral (Dassault Systemes)
sources.use: CAD models of lab parts, for example a generic 0.2 mL tube with cap

sources.name: GrabCAD Community Library
sources.use: Free CAD models, including PCR tubes

sources.name: Printables
sources.use: Printable models; mostly accessories such as racks, rarely accurate parts

sources.name: NIH 3D
sources.licenceText: Per entry; many are public domain

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons (3D files)
sources.use: Free 3D files with a clear licence; few in biology

sources.name: Maker data sheets (SPL, Axygen/Corning, Eppendorf, Thermo Fisher, Bio-Rad)
sources.use: Dimensions, materials and volumes of lab consumables, to check a 3D model against

sources.name: RDKit MolDraw2D (ACS-1996)
sources.use: 2D chemical structures in ACS-1996 style from checked SMILES; rdDetermineBonds rebuilds connectivity from 3D coordinates

sources.name: SAMSON (OneAngstrom)
sources.use: 3D molecular complexes, sticks and balls-and-sticks with soft studio lighting and clear camera

sources.name: Molecular Nodes (Blender 5.2+)
sources.use: Import PDB, mmCIF and trajectories into Blender Geometry Nodes for Cycles and EEVEE studio rendering

sources.name: Open Babel
sources.use: Convert chemical file formats, generate 3D coordinates and perceive bonds for typed contacts
